entities.summary: Melchior Shi Hongzhen is a Chinese Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Tianjin since 2019. He had been under house arrest after refusing to join Chinese Patriotic Catholic Association. The government recognized him as bishop of Tianjin in 2024.
